text: Light everything built before nineteen forty.
Bombs and fire took much of the centre.
asr: Bombs and fire took much of the centre.

text: Then, layer by layer, it grew back.
After nineteen ninety, it crossed the river, and climbed.
asr: After 1990, it crossed the river, and climbed.

text: At midwinter noon, the sun stays below fifteen degrees.
asr: At midwinter noon, the sun stays below 15 degrees.

text: The tallest tower's shadow runs nearly eight hundred metres,
asr: The tallest tower's shadow runs nearly 800 metres,

text: across sixteen roofs. Nine were there before the war.
asr: across 16 roofs. Nine were there before the war.
